# CANDIDATE: V14E_KEEPER_TOP

**Filed:** 2026-09-07
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The V14E enhancer adds a 5/12 anchor day and SNIPER-style profit-lock knobs to capture more consistent bearish edge while avoiding over-reliance on extreme volatility days. The top keeper attempts to improve edge capture by tightening profit-lock parameters and adjusting entry timing.

## Mechanism

- **Entry:** Bearish triggers with `strike_offset_bear=0` (ATM puts), `min_triggers_bear=1` (single trigger sufficient), no trades before 09:35 ET.
- **Exit:** 
  - TP1 at 30% premium (`tp1_premium_pct=0.3`) scaling out 50% of position (`tp1_qty_fraction=0.5`)
  - Profit-lock arms at 5% gain (`profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.05`) with stop offset at 10% (`profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.1`)
  - Runner target at 250% premium (`runner_target_premium_pct=2.5`)
  - Catastrophe stop at 20% loss (`premium_stop_pct_bear=-0.2`)
